Get the minimum position where rzone is active\\\\n            rz_start_pos = trial_pos[rz_active].min()\\\\n            rz_starts[t] = rz_start_pos\\\\n            rz_labels[t] = determine_reward_zone_label(rz_start_pos)\\\\n    \\\\n    return rz_starts, rz_labels\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, trial_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get the reward zone label for a specific trial.\\\\n    For omission trials, infer from neighboring trials.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    if rz_labels[trial_idx] is not None:\\\\n        return rz_labels[trial_idx]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Search forward and backward for nearest non-None label\\\\n    for offset in range(1, len(rz_labels)):\\\\n        if trial_idx - offset >= 0 and rz_labels[trial_idx - offset] is not None:\\\\n            return rz_labels[trial_idx - offset]\\\\n        if trial_idx + offset < len(rz_labels) and rz_labels[trial_idx + offset] is not None:\\\\n            return rz_labels[trial_idx + offset]\\\\n    \\\\n    return 'A'  # fallback\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_distance_to_reward_zone(position, rz_start):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute signed distance from current position to nearest point in reward zone.\\\\n    Reward zone spans [rz_start, rz_start + 50].\\\\n    Negative = before reward zone, positive = after.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    rz_end = rz_start + 50.0\\\\n    distance = np.zeros_like(position)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Before reward zone\\\\n    before_mask = position < rz_start\\\\n    distance[before_mask] = position[before_mask] - rz_start\\\\n    \\\\n    # In reward zone\\\\n    in_mask = (position >= rz_start) & (position <= rz_end)\\\\n    distance[in_mask] = 0.0\\\\n    \\\\n    # After reward zone\\\\n    after_mask = position > rz_end\\\\n    distance[after_mask] = position[after_mask] - rz_end\\\\n    \\\\n    return distance\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_distance(distance):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize distance to reward zone into 7 bins.\\\\n    0: < -50 cm\\\\n    1: -50 to -10 cm\\\\n    2: -10 cm to < 0 cm\\\\n    3: 0 cm\\\\n    4: >0 cm to +10 cm\\\\n    5: +10 to +50 cm\\\\n    6: > +50 cm\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bins = np.zeros(len(distance), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    bins[distance < -50] = 0\\\\n    bins[(distance >= -50) & (distance < -10)] = 1\\\\n    bins[(distance >= -10) & (distance < 0)] = 2\\\\n    bins[distance == 0] = 3\\\\n    bins[(distance > 0) & (distance <= 10)] = 4\\\\n    bins[(distance > 10) & (distance <= 50)] = 5\\\\n    bins[distance > 50] = 6\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_position(position, n_bins=5):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize absolute position into n_bins equal-sized bins.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, TRACK_LENGTH, n_bins + 1)\\\\n    bins = np.digitize(position, bin_edges[1:])  # 0 to n_bins-1\\\\n    bins = np.clip(bins, 0, n_bins - 1)\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_speed(speed):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize speed into 5 bins.\\\\n    0: < 2 cm/s\\\\n    1: 2-10 cm/s\\\\n    2: 10-20 cm/s\\\\n    3: 20-40 cm/s\\\\n    4: > 40 cm/s\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    bins[speed < 2] = 0\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 2) & (speed < 10)] = 1\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 10) & (speed < 20)] = 2\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 20) & (speed < 40)] = 3\\\\n    bins[speed >= 40] = 4\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_licks(lick_data, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process lick data following reference code logic.\\\\n    1. Detect and remove lick sensor errors\\\\n    2. Clip to [0, 1] (binary)\\\\n    3. Smooth with Gaussian\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    licks = np.copy(lick_data).astype(np.float64)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Lick sensor error correction per trial\\\\n    for t in range(len(trial_start_inds)):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        trial_licks = licks[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        # If >35% of samples have cumulative lick count > 2, set to NaN\\\\n        if len(trial_licks) > 0:\\\\n            frac_high = np.sum(trial_licks > 2) / len(trial_licks)\\\\n            if frac_high > LICK_ERROR_THRESHOLD:\\\\n                licks[t_start:t_end] = np.nan\\\\n    \\\\n    # Clip to [0, 1]\\\\n    licks[licks > 1] = 1\\\\n    \\\\n    return licks\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process a single NWB file and return trial-level data.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    t0 = time.time()\\\\n    \\\\n    f = h5py.File(nwb_path, 'r')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract metadata\\\\n    subj_id = f['general']['subject']['subject_id'][()].decode()\\\\n    sess_id = f['general']['session_id'][()].decode()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract behavioral data\\\\n    beh = f['processing']['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries']\\\\n    position = beh['position']['data'][:]\\\\n    speed_data = beh['speed']['data'][:]\\\\n    lick_data = beh['lick']['data'][:]\\\\n    rzone = beh['reward_zone']['data'][:]\\\\n    env_data = beh['environment']['data'][:]\\\\n    trial_start_markers = beh['trial_start']['data'][:]\\\\n    teleport_markers = beh['teleport']['data'][:]\\\\n    scanning = beh['scanning']['data'][:]\\\\n    reward_timestamps = beh['Reward']['timestamps'][:]\\\\n    pos_timestamps = beh['position']['timestamps'][:]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract neural data\\\\n    deconv_data = f['processing']['ophys']['Deconvolved']['plane0']['data'][:]  # (n_timepoints, n_rois)\\\\n    iscell = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']['iscell'][:]\\\\n    \\\\n    f.close()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Filter neurons by iscell\\\\n    cell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\\\\n    neural_all = deconv_data[:, cell_mask].T  # (n_neurons, n_timepoints)\\\\n    n_neurons = neural_all.shape[0]\\\\n    n_timepoints = neural_all.shape[1]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get trial boundaries\\\\n    trial_start_inds = np.where(trial_start_markers > 0)[0]\\\\n    teleport_inds = np.where(teleport_markers > 0)[0]\\\\n    n_trials = len(trial_start_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    if n_trials != len(teleport_inds):\\\\n        print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: trial_start ({n_trials}) != teleport ({len(teleport_inds)}) count\\\\\\\")\\\\n        n_trials = min(n_trials, len(teleport_inds))\\\\n        trial_start_inds = trial_start_inds[:n_trials]\\\\n        teleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Compute frame rate\\\\n    dt = np.median(np.diff(pos_timestamps))\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone info per trial\\\\n    rz_starts, rz_labels = get_reward_zone_start_per_trial(\\\\n        position, rzone, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Process licks\\\\n    licks_processed = process_licks(lick_data, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Determine reward per trial\\\\n    # Convert reward timestamps to frame indices\\\\n    reward_frame_inds = np.searchsorted(pos_timestamps, reward_timestamps)\\\\n    reward_frame_inds = np.clip(reward_frame_inds, 0, n_timepoints - 1)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build per-trial reward binary\\\\n    trial_rewarded = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        # Check if any reward was delivered in this trial\\\\n        reward_in_trial = np.any(\\\\n            (reward_frame_inds >= t_start) & (reward_frame_inds < t_end)\\\\n        )\\\\n        trial_rewarded[t] = 1 if reward_in_trial else 0\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get environment type per trial\\\\n    trial_env = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        env_vals = env_data[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        env_vals = env_vals[env_vals >= 0]  # exclude -1\\\\n        if len(env_vals) > 0:\\\\n            trial_env[t] = int(np.median(env_vals))\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone label per trial (for output)\\\\n    trial_rz_label = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    rz_label_map = {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, t)\\\\n        trial_rz_label[t] = rz_label_map.get(label, 0)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone start position per trial (for distance computation)\\\\n    # For omission trials, use the same reward zone as neighboring trials\\\\n    trial_rz_start = np.zeros(n_trials)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, t)\\\\n        trial_rz_start[t] = REWARD_ZONES[label][0]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build trial data\\\\n    neural_trials = []\\\\n    input_trials = []\\\\n    output_trials = []\\\\n    \\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        n_tp = t_end - t_start\\\\n        \\\\n        if n_tp < 2:\\\\n            continue\\\\n        \\\\n        # Neural data for this trial\\\\n        trial_neural = neural_all[:, t_start:t_end].astype(np.float32)\\\\n        \\\\n        # --- INPUTS ---\\\\n        # Time from start of trial (seconds)\\\\n        time_from_start = np.arange(n_tp) * dt\\\\n        \\\\n        # Environment type (binary, per trial)\\\\n        env_type = float(trial_env[t])\\\\n        \\\\n        # Trial number (continuous, per trial)\\\\n        trial_num = float(t)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Previous trial outcome (binary, per trial)\\\\n        if t == 0:\\\\n            prev_outcome = 0.0\\\\n        else:\\\\n            prev_outcome = float(trial_rewarded[t - 1])\\\\n        \\\\n        # Build input array\\\\n        # Time-varying: time_from_start (n_tp,)\\\\n        # Per-trial: env_type, trial_num, prev_outcome\\\\n        input_data = np.zeros((4, n_tp), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        input_data[0, :] = time_from_start\\\\n        input_data[1, :] = env_type\\\\n        input_data[2, :] = trial_num\\\\n        input_data[3, :] = prev_outcome\\\\n        \\\\n        # --- OUTPUTS ---\\\\n        trial_pos = position[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_speed = speed_data[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_licks = licks_processed[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Distance to reward zone (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n        rz_start = trial_rz_start[t]\\\\n        distance = compute_distance_to_reward_zone(trial_pos, rz_start)\\\\n        dist_bins = discretize_distance(distance)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Absolute position (time-varying, discretized into 5 bins)\\\\n        pos_bins = discretize_position(trial_pos, n_bins=5)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Speed (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n        speed_bins = discretize_speed(np.abs(trial_speed))  # use absolute speed\\\\n        \\\\n        # Lick (time-varying, binary)\\\\n        lick_binary = np.zeros(n_tp, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        if not np.all(np.isnan(trial_licks)):\\\\n            # Smooth licks\\\\n            smoothed_licks = nansmooth(trial_licks, LICK_SMOOTH_SIGMA)\\\\n            # Convert to binary: > 0.5 threshold after smoothing\\\\n            lick_binary = (smoothed_licks > 0.5).astype(np.int64)\\\\n            lick_binary[np.isnan(smoothed_licks)] = 0\\\\n        \\\\n        # Reward zone location (per-trial)\\\\n        rz_loc = trial_rz_label[t]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Reward outcome (per-trial)\\\\n        reward_out = trial_rewarded[t]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Build output array\\\\n        # Time-varying: dist_bins, pos_bins, speed_bins, lick_binary\\\\n        # Per-trial: rz_loc, reward_out\\\\n        output_data = np.zeros((6, n_tp), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        output_data[0, :] = dist_bins\\\\n        output_data[1, :] = pos_bins\\\\n        output_data[2, :] = speed_bins\\\\n        output_data[3, :] = lick_binary\\\\n        output_data[4, :] = rz_loc\\\\n        output_data[5, :] = reward_out\\\\n        \\\\n        neural_trials.append(trial_neural)\\\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\\\n        output_trials.append(output_data)\\\\n    \\\\n    elapsed = time.time() - t0\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"  {subj_id} ses-{sess_id}: {n_neurons} neurons, {len(neural_trials)} trials, \\\\\\\"\\\\n          f\\\\\\\"{n_tp} timepoints (last trial), dt={dt*1000:.1f}ms, {elapsed:.1f}s\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    if show_processing and session_idx < 2:\\\\n        plot_processing(subj_id, sess_id, position, speed_data, licks_processed,\\\\n                       trial_start_inds, teleport_inds, neural_all, \\\\n                       rz_starts, rz_labels, trial_rewarded, trial_env,\\\\n                       pos_timestamps, dt, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                       session_idx)\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n        'neural_trials': neural_trials,\\\\n        'input_trials': input_trials,\\\\n        'output_trials': output_trials,\\\\n        'subj_id': subj_id,\\\\n        'sess_id': sess_id,\\\\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\\\\n        'dt': dt,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef plot_processing(subj_id, sess_id, position, speed, licks,\\\\n                   trial_start_inds, teleport_inds, neural_all,\\\\n                   rz_starts, rz_labels, trial_rewarded, trial_env,\\\\n                   pos_timestamps, dt, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                   session_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Plot processing steps for visual verification.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    import matplotlib\\\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\\\n    \\\\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(6, 2, figsize=(20, 24))\\\\n    fig.suptitle(f'{subj_id} ses-{sess_id}', fontsize=16)\\\\n    \\\\n    n_trials = len(trial_start_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 1: Position over time for first 10 trials\\\\n    ax = axes[0, 0]\\\\n    for t in range(min(10, n_trials)):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        ts = pos_timestamps[t_start:t_end] - ax.set_title('Position traces (first 10 trials)')\\\\n    ax.legend(fontsize=6)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 2: Speed distribution\\\\n    ax = axes[0, 1]\\\\n    valid_speed = speed[speed > -100]\\\\n    ax.hist(valid_speed, bins=100, range=(-5, 80))\\\\n    ax.axvline(2, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Speed threshold')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Speed (cm/s)')\\\\n    ax.set_title('Speed distribution')\\\\n    ax.legend()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 3: Neural activity heatmap (first trial)\\\\n    ax = axes[1, 0]\\\\n    if len(neural_trials) > 0:\\\\n        trial_data = neural_trials[0]\\\\n        n_show = min(50, trial_data.shape[0])\\\\n        ax.imshow(trial_data[:n_show, :], aspect='auto', cmap='hot')\\\\n        ax.set_xlabel('Timepoints')\\\\n        ax.set_ylabel('Neuron')\\\\n        ax.set_title('Neural activity (Trial 0, first 50 neurons)')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 4: Reward zone positions across trials\\\\n    ax = axes[1, 1]\\\\n    colors = ax.set_xlabel('Trial')\\\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Reward zone start (cm)')\\\\n    ax.set_title('Reward zone locations')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 5: Distance to reward zone (first trial)\\\\n    ax = axes[2, 0]\\\\n    if len(output_trials) > 0:\\\\n        ax.plot(output_trials[0][0, :], label='Distance bin')\\\\n        ax.set_xlabel('Timepoints')\\\\n        ax.set_ylabel('Distance bin')\\\\n        ax.set_title('Distance to RZ (Trial 0)')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 6: Position bins (first trial)\\\\n    ax = axes[2, 1]\\\\n    if len(output_trials) > 0:\\\\n        ax.plot(output_trials[0][1, :], label='Position bin')\\\\n        ax.set_xlabel('Timepoints')\\\\n        ax.set_ylabel('Position bin')\\\\n        ax.set_title('Position bins (Trial 0)')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 7: Speed bins plt.savefig(f'processing_{subj_id}_ses{sess_id}.png', dpi=100)\\\\n    plt.close()\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"  Saved processing plot: processing_{subj_id}_ses{sess_id}.png\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef main():\\\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert NWB data to decoder format')\\\\n    parser.add_argument('output', help='Output pickle file path')\\\\n    parser.add_argument('--full', action='store_true', default=True, help='Process all sessions')\\\\n    parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Process only 2 sessions')\\\\n    parser.add_argument('--show-processing', action='store_true', help='Show processing plots')\\\\n    args = parser.parse_args()\\\\n    \\\\n    if args.sample:\\\\n        args.full = False\\\\n    \\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"=\\\\\\\" * 60)\\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"NWB to Decoder Format Conversion\\\\\\\")\\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"=\\\\\\\" * 60)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Find all NWB files\\\\n    nwb_files = sorted(glob.glob('data/sub-*/sub-*_ses-*_behavior+ophys.nwb'))\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"Found {len(nwb_files)} NWB files\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    if args.sample:\\\\n        # Select 2 sessions from different subjects\\\\n        nwb_files = [nwb_files[0], nwb_files[14]]  # m11 ses-03 and m12 ses-01\\\\n        print(f\\\\\\\"Sample mode: processing {len(nwb_files)} sessions\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    # Process all sessions\\\\n    all_neural = []\\\\n    all_input = []\\\\n    all_output = []\\\\n    all_subj_ids = []\\\\n    all_sess_ids = []\\\\n    all_n_neurons = []\\\\n    all_dts = {os.path.basename(nwb_file)}\\\\\\\")\\\\n        result = process_session(nwb_file, show_processing=args.show_processing, session_idx=i)\\\\n        \\\\n        if len(result['neural_trials']) < all_sess_ids.append(result['sess_id'])\\\\n        all_n_neurons.append(result['n_neurons'])\\\\n        all_dts.append(result['dt'])\\\\n    \\\\n    total_elapsed = time.time() - total_t0\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\nTotal processing time: {total_elapsed:.1f}s\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build subjects list\\\\n    unique_subjects = sorted(set(all_subj_ids), key=lambda x: int(x[1:]) if brain_region_idx = []\\\\n    for n_neurons in all_n_neurons:\\\\n        brain_region_idx.append(np.zeros(n_neurons, dtype=np.int64))  # all CA1\\\\n    \\\\n    # Compute median dt for metadata\\\\n    median_dt = np.median(all_dts)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build the data dictionary\\\\n    data = {\\\\n        'neural': all_neural,\\\\n        'input': all_input,\\\\n        'output': all_output,\\\\n        \\\\n        'subjects': unique_subjects,\\\\n        'subject_idx': subject_idx,\\\\n        \\\\n        'brain_regions': brain_regions,\\\\n        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,\\\\n ],\\\\n        \\\\n        'output_names': [\\\\n            'distance_to_reward_zone',\\\\n            'absolute_position',\\\\n            'speed',\\\\n            'lick',\\\\n            'reward_zone_location',\\\\n            'reward_outcome',\\\\n        ],\\\\n        \\\\n        'output_values': [\\\\n            ['< -50cm', '-50 to -10cm', '-10 to 0cm', '0cm', '0 to +10cm', '+10 ['no_lick', 'lick'],\\\\n            ['zone_A', 'zone_B', 'zone_C'],\\\\n            ['no_reward', 'reward'],\\\\n        ],\\\\n        \\\\n        'metadata': {\\\\n            'task_description': 'Hidden reward zone task on 450cm virtual linear track with 2 environments and 3 possible reward zones (A/B/C). If at all possible, make it time-varying\\n   145→  - If an output is a time such as when a behavior occurred, represent it as a binary time series. \\n   146→\\n   147→- **subjects**: List of names of all unique subjects (mice).\\n   148→- **subject_idx**: Index into subjects for each session.\\n   149→  - Order should match order of sessions in `neural`, etc.\\n   150→\\n   151→- **brain_regions**: List of names of all brain regions recorded from.\\n   152→- **brain_region_idx**: Index into brain_regions for each neuron in each session.\\n   153→\\n   154→- **input_names**: Names of each input variable.\\n   155→  - Order should match order of `input` dimensions. \\n   156→\\n   157→- **output_names**: Names of each output variable.\\n   158→  - Order should match order of `output` dimensions.\\n   159→- **output_values**: Names of each output value for each output variable.\\n   160→  - Order should match categorical `output` values.\\n   161→\\n   162→- **metadata**: Descriptive information. \\n   163→  - `task_description`: Concise description of the task\\n   164→  - `temporal_alignment_event`: Concise description of temporal alignment event\\n   165→  - `off_start`: Signed time from alignment event to start of trial. Negative means before event, positive after. \\n   166→  - `off_end`: Signed time from alignment event to end of trial\\n   167→  - Add other relevant fields, e.g. `session_info`\\n   168→\\n   169→## Python environment\\n   170→\\n   171→- All required Python packages are already installed in the system Python environment.\\n   172→- Use `python3` to run any python code.\\n   173→- If you need to install additional libraries, use `pip install`.\\n   174→\\n   175→## Decoder Reference\\n   176→\\n   177→- Run this script with `python train_decoder.py <data_file_path>` to validate.\\n   178→- Optional arguments:\\n   179→  - `--verify-only`: Only verify data format and print summary, then exit (does not train decoder).\\n   180→  - `--plot-samples`: Plot sample trials from data and save to png files.\\n   181→  - `--cpu`: Force torch to use CPU only (use if GPU runs out of memory).\\n   182→- Pipe the output to the designated file so that the user can examine it.\\n   183→\\n   184→### Purpose\\n   185→\\n   186→These functions will be used during the validation phase to ensure:\\n   187→1. Data structure is correct - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \\n   188→2. Dimensions are consistent - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \\n   189→3. Values are sensible - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \\n   190→4. Decoder can successfully train and predict\\n   191→5. Poor performance indicates data formatting issues that need investigation\\n   192→\\n   193→### Consistency requirements\\n   194→\\n   195→Your processing and formatting must **match the reference paper and code** with respect to:\\n   196→- Loading of data\\n   197→- Temporal alignment of different time series streams (neural, inputs, outputs)\\n   198→- Processing of neural, input, and output data streams\\n   199→- Curation of data: filtering of low-quality neurons, trials, sessions, and mice.\\n   200→\\n   201→To check consistency, you must compare statistics available in the reference paper and your converted dataset. \\n   202→\\n   203→Whenever possible, invent **SANITY CHECKS** that your loading and processing matches the reference paper and code. \\n   204→\\n   205→Discrepancies are only allowed if required by the Decoder Input and Decoder Output specifications above. \\n   206→\\n   207→Carefully verify your work after every step. When you find mistakes, document and fix them immediately. Be critical of results **after every step of processing**. \\n   208→\\n   209→You will be assessed on whether the decisions you make on how to load, filter, process, align, reformat, and save the data are reasonable and match the reference paper and code and these instructions. During testing, the reference version of `train_decoder.py` will be run on your converted data. Data statistics and decoder accuracy will be compared to those achieved by human-written conversion code. \\n   210→\\n   211→---\\n   212→\\n   213→## Conversion Workflow\\n   214→\\n   215→**IMPORTANT**: Follow these steps in order. Run `python -u train_decoder.py converted_data.pkl --verify-only 2>&1 | tee verification_full_out.txt`. \\n   448→6. Check that no data was lost during conversion \\n   449→7. Perform all of the following checks:\\n   529→\\n   530→**Check 1: Accuracy vs chance analysis**\\n   531→- For each output, compare validation accuracy to chance (1/num_classes)\\n   532→- Accuracy below chance indicates a bug, investigate and fix conversion issues to improve this. \\n   533→- Accuracy below 1.5x chance may also indicate a bug, investigate whether changes in conversion logic could improve accuracy. \\n   534→\\n   535→**Check 2: Accuracy comparison to paper**\\n   536→- Find every decoding accuracy reported in the reference paper\\n   537→- Create a table comparing your accuracy to the paper's accuracy for each variable\\n   538→- If your accuracy is lower than the reported accuracy, this may indicate a bug in your conversion that you must fix. \\n   539→- Differences in algorithm/architecture should be relatively small because of the data dimensionality and size. Do not use this as an excuse to dismiss differences, investigate them completely before moving on. \\n   540→\\n   541→**Check 3: Train vs validation gap**\\n   542→- If training accuracy is much higher (>1.5x) than validation accuracy for any output, investigate overfitting or data leakage. \\n   543→\\n   544→**If accuracy is low for an output, try these specific debugging steps:**\\n   545→1. Check that filtering steps for neural activity streams are followed. \\n   549→5. Check that processing of the data matches the reference code and paper. \\n   550→\\n   551→**Iteration protocol**: If ANY check above reveals an issue:\\n   552→1. Fix the issue in convert_data.py\\n   553→2. Re-run the affected conversion and validation steps\\n   554→3. Re-run ALL checks in this step (not just the one that failed)\\n   555→4. What variables in the raw data is `output` *Distance to reward zone* derived from?\\n   301→\\n   302→i. To allow for some noise (of unknown source) and unrewarded tasks, I use the Viterbi algorithm to assign zones so that the rewarded positions match the known reward zones and it is uncommon to switch reward zone. \\n   303→\\n   304→ii. Assigning reward zone location for each trial: \\n   305→- Before converting, the `survey()` function was used to try to understand all the data values, including whatever is going on with the `reward_zone` variable. It first computes the position of the min and max position of the mouse when `reward_zone` is non-zero:\\n   306→```python\\n   307→behavior_data = nwbfile.processing['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries'].time_series       \\n   308→info['reward_zone_positions'] = np.full((ntrials, 2), np.nan)\\n   309→position = behavior_data['position'].data[:]\\n   310→for trial in range(ntrials):\\n   311→    idx = np.arange(trial_start_idx[trial], trial_end_idx[trial], dtype=int)\\n   312→    pos_trial = position[idx]\\n   313→    reward_zone_trial = reward_zone[idx] > 0\\n   314→    if not np.any(reward_zone_trial):\\n   315→        continue\\n   316→    info['reward_zone_positions'][trial] = [np.min(pos_trial[reward_zone_trial]), np.max(pos_trial[reward_zone_trial])]\\n   317→```\\n   318→The function `segment_reward_positions()` uses the Viterbi algorithm to assign reward zone labels so that the initial rewarded positions are close to the corresponding rewarded zone:\\n   319→```python\\n   320→reward_zone_dict = {'A': [80, 130],\\n   321→                    'B': [200, 250],\\n   322→                    'C': [320, 370]}\\n   323→...\\n   324→sigma = 10.0  # std dev for Gaussian emission on zone distance\\n   325→zone_ranges = np.array([reward_zone_dict[z] for z in zone_names])  # (n_states, 2)\\n   326→dist = np.maximum(zone_ranges[None, :, 0] - startpoints[valid, None],\\n   327→                    startpoints[valid, None] - zone_ranges[None, :, 1]) # negative if inside the zone, positive if outside\\n   328→dist = np.maximum(dist, 0)\\n   329→log_emission[valid] = -0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2\\n   330→```\\n   331→It also encourages the reward zone label to not change often:\\n   332→```python\\n   333→pstay = .9\\n   334→log_trans = np.full((n_states, n_states), np.log((1 - pstay) / (n_states - 1)))\\n   335→np.fill_diagonal(log_trans, np.log(pstay))\\n   336→```\\n   337→\\n   338→iii. I plotted the position of the mouse when `reward_zone` was positive (note that the value was between 0 and 6 I think) to determine that the Viterbi approach would likely work, and that the start of the rewarded position was the least noisy variable to use. The class fractions were approximately 1/3 after this, so it seemed correct. \\n   339→\\n   340→## 7-b. How are minor mistakes in the data, e.g. missing data, handled?\\n\\ni. Several cases are handled:\\n- **Neural/behavior length mismatch**: If the number of neural time bins differs from behavior timestamps, data is cropped to the minimum of the two with a warning printed.\\n- **Short trials**: Trials with fewer than 50 timepoints (`min_ntimepoints`) are skipped with a warning.\\n- **Missing reward zone data**: Trials where `reward_zone` is never active (all zeros) get NaN positions, and the Viterbi algorithm handles these via uniform emission (assignment driven by neighboring trials' transitions).\\n- **Reward timestamp alignment**: An assertion verifies reward times align within half a time bin of behavior timestamps.\\n\\nii.\\n```python\\nif T != len(timestamps):\\n    print(f\\\"Warning: number of neural time bins ({T}) does not match number of behavior timestamps ({len(timestamps)}), cropping to the minimum of the two\\\")\\n    T = min(T, len(timestamps))\\n    spike_data = spike_data[:T]\\n    timestamps = timestamps[:T]\\n...\\nif idx.sum() < min_ntimepoints:\\n    print(f\\\"Skipping trial {trial}...\\\")\\n    istrial[trial] = False\\n    continue\\n```\\n\\niii. What loops in the code could have been vectorized to improve efficiency?\\n\\ni. The per-trial loop in `convert_session_data` (lines 267-332) iterates over each trial sequentially. Some operations like `np.digitize` and `compute_distance_to_reward_zone` could theoretically be applied to the full session arrays before splitting into trials, but the variable trial lengths make this awkward. The Viterbi inner loop (lines 503-507) iterates over states, which could be vectorized with matrix operations.\\n\\nii. N/A\\n\\niii. The per-trial loop is the natural structure given variable-length trials. Vectorizing would require padding or masking.\\n\\n## 13-c. What processing does the code repeat multiple times?\\n\\ni. The survey step and the conversion step both load every NWB file and read the same data arrays (neural, behavior). The survey reads neural data to count neurons and check rates, then the conversion reads it again. The `reward_zone_positions` are computed in the survey and then used in the conversion, but other data (position, speed, lick, etc.) is read twice. \\n\\nii. N/A\\n\\niii. I don't think these could be run at the same time, as it would require too much RAM. The Viterbi output created during surveying is required to process the data. all_info\\n\\ndef segment_reward_positions(reward_zone_positions):\\n    # assign each trial to one of the reward zones defined in reward_zone_dict\\n    # use viterbi algorithm with a high cost for switching to encourage stable assignments\\n    zone_names = sorted(reward_zone_dict.keys())\\n    n_states = len(zone_names)\\n    zone_ranges = np.array([reward_zone_dict[z] for z in zone_names])  # (n_states, 2)\\n    pstay = .9\\n    sigma = 10.0  # std dev for Gaussian emission on zone distance\\n\\n    # transition log-probabilities\\n    log_trans = np.full((n_states, n_states), np.log((1 - pstay) / (n_states - 1)))\\n    np.fill_diagonal(log_trans, np.log(pstay))\\n\\n    results = {}\\n\\n    for mouse_id, positions in reward_zone_positions.items():\\n        n_trials = positions.shape[0]\\n        startpoints = positions[:,0] # use the start point as it looks cleaner\\n        valid = ~np.isnan(startpoints)\\n\\n        # emission log-probabilities: Gaussian penalty based on distance to zone range\\n        # distance is 0 if inside [lo, hi], otherwise distance to nearest edge\\n        # for NaN trials, uniform emission (all zeros) so assignment is driven by transitions\\n        log_emission = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\\n        dist = np.maximum(zone_ranges[None, :, 0] - startpoints[valid, None],\\n                          startpoints[valid, None] - zone_ranges[None, :, 1]) # negative if inside the zone, positive if outside\\n        dist = np.maximum(dist, 0)\\n        log_emission[valid] = -0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2\\n\\n        # viterbi forward pass\\n        log_delta = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\\n        psi = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states), dtype=int)\\n        log_delta[0] = log_emission[0]  # uniform prior\\n        for t in range(1, n_trials):\\n            for k in range(n_states):\\n                scores = log_delta[t - 1] + log_trans[:, k]\\n                psi[t, k] = np.argmax(scores)\\n                log_delta[t, k] = scores[psi[t, k]] + log_emission[t, k]\\n\\n        # backtrack\\n        states = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=int)\\n        states[-1] = np.argmax(log_delta[-1])\\n        for t in range(n_trials - 2, -1, -1):\\n            states[t] = psi[t + 1, states[t + 1]]\\n\\n        # convert state indices to zone names\\n        zone_labels = np.array([zone_names[s] for s in states])\\n\\n        # distance from each trial's startpoint to its assigned zone range\\n        assigned_lo = zone_ranges[states, 0]\\n        assigned_hi = zone_ranges[states, 1]\\n        zone_dist = np.maximum(np.maximum(assigned_lo - startpoints, startpoints - assigned_hi), 0)\\n        zone_dist[~valid] = np.nan\\n\\n        results[mouse_id] = {'zone_labels': zone_labels, 'states': states, 'zone_dist': zone_dist}\\n\\n    return results\\n    \\n\\ndef main():\\n\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert Sosa et al. 2024 NWB data to pickle format.')\\n all_info\\n\\ndef segment_reward_positions(reward_zone_positions):\\n    # assign each trial to one of the reward zones defined in reward_zone_dict\\n    # use viterbi algorithm with a high cost for switching to encourage stable assignments\\n    zone_names = sorted(reward_zone_dict.keys())\\n    n_states = len(zone_names)\\n    zone_ranges = np.array([reward_zone_dict[z] for z in zone_names])  # (n_states, 2)\\n    pstay = .9\\n    sigma = 10.0  # std dev for Gaussian emission on zone distance\\n\\n    # transition log-probabilities\\n    log_trans = np.full((n_states, n_states), np.log((1 - pstay) / (n_states - 1)))\\n    np.fill_diagonal(log_trans, np.log(pstay))\\n\\n    results = {}\\n\\n    for mouse_id, positions in reward_zone_positions.items():\\n        n_trials = positions.shape[0]\\n        startpoints = positions[:,0] # use the start point as it looks cleaner\\n        valid = ~np.isnan(startpoints)\\n\\n        # emission log-probabilities: Gaussian penalty based on distance to zone range\\n        # distance is 0 if inside [lo, hi], otherwise distance to nearest edge\\n        # for NaN trials, uniform emission (all zeros) so assignment is driven by transitions\\n        log_emission = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\\n        dist = np.maximum(zone_ranges[None, :, 0] - startpoints[valid, None],\\n                          startpoints[valid, None] - zone_ranges[None, :, 1]) # negative if inside the zone, positive if outside\\n        dist = np.maximum(dist, 0)\\n        log_emission[valid] = -0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2\\n\\n        # viterbi forward pass\\n        log_delta = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\\n        psi = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states), dtype=int)\\n        log_delta[0] = log_emission[0]  # uniform prior\\n        for t in range(1, n_trials):\\n            for k in range(n_states):\\n                scores = log_delta[t - 1] + log_trans[:, k]\\n                psi[t, k] = np.argmax(scores)\\n                log_delta[t, k] = scores[psi[t, k]] + log_emission[t, k]\\n\\n        # backtrack\\n        states = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=int)\\n        states[-1] = np.argmax(log_delta[-1])\\n        for t in range(n_trials - 2, -1, -1):\\n            states[t] = psi[t + 1, states[t + 1]]\\n\\n        # convert state indices to zone names\\n        zone_labels = np.array([zone_names[s] for s in states])\\n\\n        # distance from each trial's startpoint to its assigned zone range\\n        assigned_lo = zone_ranges[states, 0]\\n        assigned_hi = zone_ranges[states, 1]\\n        zone_dist = np.maximum(np.maximum(assigned_lo - startpoints, startpoints - assigned_hi), 0)\\n        zone_dist[~valid] = np.nan\\n\\n        results[mouse_id] = {'zone_labels': zone_labels, 'states': states, 'zone_dist': zone_dist}\\n\\n    return results\\n    \\n\\ndef main():\\n\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert Sosa et al. 2024 NWB data to pickle format.')\\n Search forward and backward for nearest non-None label\\\\n    for offset in range(1, len(rz_labels)):\\\\n        if trial_idx - offset >= 0 and rz_labels[trial_idx - offset] is not None:\\\\n            return rz_labels[trial_idx - offset]\\\\n        if trial_idx + offset < len(rz_labels) and rz_labels[trial_idx + offset] is not None:\\\\n            return rz_labels[trial_idx + offset]\\\\n    \\\\n    return 'A'  # fallback\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_distance_to_reward_zone(position, rz_start):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute signed distance from current position to nearest point in reward zone.\\\\n    Reward zone spans [rz_start, rz_start + 50].\\\\n    Negative = before reward zone, positive = after.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    rz_end = rz_start + 50.0\\\\n    distance = np.zeros_like(position)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Before reward zone\\\\n    before_mask = position < rz_start\\\\n    distance[before_mask] = position[before_mask] - rz_start\\\\n    \\\\n    # In reward zone\\\\n    in_mask = (position >= rz_start) & (position <= rz_end)\\\\n    distance[in_mask] = 0.0\\\\n    \\\\n    # After reward zone\\\\n    after_mask = position > rz_end\\\\n    distance[after_mask] = position[after_mask] - rz_end\\\\n    \\\\n    return distance\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_distance(distance):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize distance to reward zone into 7 bins.\\\\n    0: < -50 cm\\\\n    1: -50 to -10 cm\\\\n    2: -10 cm to < 0 cm\\\\n    3: 0 cm\\\\n    4: >0 cm to +10 cm\\\\n    5: +10 to +50 cm\\\\n    6: > +50 cm\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bins = np.zeros(len(distance), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    bins[distance < -50] = 0\\\\n    bins[(distance >= -50) & (distance < -10)] = 1\\\\n    bins[(distance >= -10) & (distance < 0)] = 2\\\\n    bins[distance == 0] = 3\\\\n    bins[(distance > 0) & (distance <= 10)] = 4\\\\n    bins[(distance > 10) & (distance <= 50)] = 5\\\\n    bins[distance > 50] = 6\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_position(position, n_bins=5):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize absolute position into n_bins equal-sized bins.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, TRACK_LENGTH, n_bins + 1)\\\\n    bins = np.digitize(position, bin_edges[1:])  # 0 to n_bins-1\\\\n    bins = np.clip(bins, 0, n_bins - 1)\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_speed(speed):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize speed into 5 bins.\\\\n    0: < 2 cm/s\\\\n    1: 2-10 cm/s\\\\n    2: 10-20 cm/s\\\\n    3: 20-40 cm/s\\\\n    4: > 40 cm/s\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    bins[speed < 2] = 0\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 2) & (speed < 10)] = 1\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 10) & (speed < 20)] = 2\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 20) & (speed < 40)] = 3\\\\n    bins[speed >= 40] = 4\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_licks(lick_data, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process lick data following reference code logic.\\\\n    1. Detect and remove lick sensor errors\\\\n    2. Clip to [0, 1] (binary)\\\\n    3. Smooth with Gaussian\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    licks = np.copy(lick_data).astype(np.float64)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Lick sensor error correction per trial\\\\n    for t in range(len(trial_start_inds)):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        trial_licks = licks[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        # If >35% of samples have cumulative lick count > 2, set to NaN\\\\n        if len(trial_licks) > 0:\\\\n            frac_high = np.sum(trial_licks > 2) / len(trial_licks)\\\\n            if frac_high > LICK_ERROR_THRESHOLD:\\\\n                licks[t_start:t_end] = np.nan\\\\n    \\\\n    # Clip to [0, 1]\\\\n    licks[licks > 1] = 1\\\\n    \\\\n    return licks\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process a single NWB file and return trial-level data.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    t0 = time.time()\\\\n    \\\\n    f = h5py.File(nwb_path, 'r')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract metadata\\\\n    subj_id = f['general']['subject']['subject_id'][()].decode()\\\\n    sess_id = f['general']['session_id'][()].decode()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract behavioral data\\\\n    beh = f['processing']['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries']\\\\n    position = beh['position']['data'][:]\\\\n    speed_data = beh['speed']['data'][:]\\\\n    lick_data = beh['lick']['data'][:]\\\\n    rzone = beh['reward_zone']['data'][:]\\\\n    env_data = beh['environment']['data'][:]\\\\n    trial_start_markers = beh['trial_start']['data'][:]\\\\n    teleport_markers = beh['teleport']['data'][:]\\\\n    scanning = beh['scanning']['data'][:]\\\\n    reward_timestamps = beh['Reward']['timestamps'][:]\\\\n    pos_timestamps = beh['position']['timestamps'][:]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract neural data\\\\n    deconv_data = f['processing']['ophys']['Deconvolved']['plane0']['data'][:]  # (n_timepoints, n_rois)\\\\n    iscell = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']['iscell'][:]\\\\n    \\\\n    f.close()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Filter neurons by iscell\\\\n    cell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\\\\n    neural_all = deconv_data[:, cell_mask].T  # (n_neurons, n_timepoints)\\\\n    n_neurons = neural_all.shape[0]\\\\n    n_timepoints = neural_all.shape[1]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get trial boundaries\\\\n    trial_start_inds = np.where(trial_start_markers > 0)[0]\\\\n    teleport_inds = np.where(teleport_markers > 0)[0]\\\\n    n_trials = len(trial_start_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    if n_trials != len(teleport_inds):\\\\n        print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: trial_start ({n_trials}) != teleport ({len(teleport_inds)}) count\\\\\\\")\\\\n        n_trials = min(n_trials, len(teleport_inds))\\\\n        trial_start_inds = trial_start_inds[:n_trials]\\\\n        teleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Compute frame rate\\\\n    dt = np.median(np.diff(pos_timestamps))\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone info per trial\\\\n    rz_starts, rz_labels = get_reward_zone_start_per_trial(\\\\n        position, rzone, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Process licks\\\\n    licks_processed = process_licks(lick_data, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Determine reward per trial\\\\n    # Convert reward timestamps to frame indices\\\\n    reward_frame_inds = np.searchsorted(pos_timestamps, reward_timestamps)\\\\n    reward_frame_inds = np.clip(reward_frame_inds, 0, n_timepoints - 1)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build per-trial reward binary\\\\n    trial_rewarded = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        # Check if any reward was delivered in this trial\\\\n        reward_in_trial = np.any(\\\\n            (reward_frame_inds >= t_start) & (reward_frame_inds < t_end)\\\\n        )\\\\n        trial_rewarded[t] = 1 if reward_in_trial else 0\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get environment type per trial\\\\n    trial_env = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        env_vals = env_data[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        env_vals = env_vals[env_vals >= 0]  # exclude -1\\\\n        if len(env_vals) > 0:\\\\n            trial_env[t] = int(np.median(env_vals))\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone label per trial (for output)\\\\n    trial_rz_label = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    rz_label_map = {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, t)\\\\n        trial_rz_label[t] = rz_label_map.get(label, 0)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone start position per trial (for distance computation)\\\\n    # For omission trials, use the same reward zone as neighboring trials\\\\n    trial_rz_start = np.zeros(n_trials)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, t)\\\\n        trial_rz_start[t] = REWARD_ZONES[label][0]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build trial data\\\\n    neural_trials = []\\\\n    input_trials = []\\\\n    output_trials = []\\\\n    \\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        n_tp = t_end - t_start\\\\n        \\\\n        if n_tp < 2:\\\\n            continue\\\\n        \\\\n        # Neural data for this trial\\\\n        trial_neural = neural_all[:, t_start:t_end].astype(np.float32)\\\\n        \\\\n        # --- INPUTS ---\\\\n        # Time from start of trial (seconds)\\\\n        time_from_start = np.arange(n_tp) * dt\\\\n        \\\\n        # Environment type (binary, per trial)\\\\n        env_type = float(trial_env[t])\\\\n        \\\\n        # Trial number (continuous, per trial)\\\\n        trial_num = float(t)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Previous trial outcome (binary, per trial)\\\\n        if t == 0:\\\\n            prev_outcome = 0.0\\\\n        else:\\\\n            prev_outcome = float(trial_rewarded[t - 1])\\\\n        \\\\n        # Build input array\\\\n        # Time-varying: time_from_start (n_tp,)\\\\n        # Per-trial: env_type, trial_num, prev_outcome\\\\n        input_data = np.zeros((4, n_tp), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        input_data[0, :] = time_from_start\\\\n        input_data[1, :] = env_type\\\\n        input_data[2, :] = trial_num\\\\n        input_data[3, :] = prev_outcome\\\\n        \\\\n        # --- OUTPUTS ---\\\\n        trial_pos = position[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_speed = speed_data[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_licks = licks_processed[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Distance to reward zone (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n        rz_start = trial_rz_start[t]\\\\n        distance = compute_distance_to_reward_zone(trial_pos, rz_start)\\\\n        dist_bins = discretize_distance(distance)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Absolute position (time-varying, discretized into 5 bins)\\\\n        pos_bins = discretize_position(trial_pos, n_bins=5)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Speed (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n        speed_bins = discretize_speed(np.abs(trial_speed))  # use absolute speed\\\\n        \\\\n        # Lick (time-varying, binary)\\\\n        lick_binary = np.zeros(n_tp, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        if not np.all(np.isnan(trial_licks)):\\\\n            # Smooth licks\\\\n            smoothed_licks = nansmooth(trial_licks, LICK_SMOOTH_SIGMA)\\\\n            # Convert to binary: > 0.5 threshold after smoothing\\\\n            lick_binary = (smoothed_licks > 0.5).astype(np.int64)\\\\n            lick_binary[np.isnan(smoothed_licks)] = 0\\\\n        \\\\n        # Reward zone location (per-trial)\\\\n        rz_loc = trial_rz_label[t]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Reward outcome (per-trial)\\\\n        reward_out = trial_rewarded[t]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Build output array\\\\n        # Time-varying: dist_bins, pos_bins, speed_bins, lick_binary\\\\n        # Per-trial: rz_loc, reward_out\\\\n        output_data = np.zeros((6, n_tp), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        output_data[0, :] = dist_bins\\\\n        output_data[1, :] = pos_bins\\\\n        output_data[2, :] = speed_bins\\\\n        output_data[3, :] = lick_binary\\\\n        output_data[4, :] = rz_loc\\\\n        output_data[5, :] = reward_out\\\\n        \\\\n        neural_trials.append(trial_neural)\\\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\\\n        output_trials.append(output_data)\\\\n    \\\\n    elapsed = time.time() - t0\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"  {subj_id} ses-{sess_id}: {n_neurons} neurons, {len(neural_trials)} trials, \\\\\\\"\\\\n          f\\\\\\\"{n_tp} timepoints (last trial), dt={dt*1000:.1f}ms, {elapsed:.1f}s\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    if show_processing and session_idx < 2:\\\\n        plot_processing(subj_id, sess_id, position, speed_data, licks_processed,\\\\n                       trial_start_inds, teleport_inds, neural_all, \\\\n                       rz_starts, rz_labels, trial_rewarded, trial_env,\\\\n                       pos_timestamps, dt, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                       session_idx)\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n        'neural_trials': neural_trials,\\\\n        'input_trials': input_trials,\\\\n        'output_trials': output_trials,\\\\n        'subj_id': subj_id,\\\\n        'sess_id': sess_id,\\\\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\\\\n        'dt': dt,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef plot_processing(subj_id, sess_id, position, speed, licks,\\\\n                   trial_start_inds, teleport_inds, neural_all,\\\\n                   rz_starts, rz_labels, trial_rewarded, trial_env,\\\\n                   pos_timestamps, dt, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                   session_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Plot processing main():\\\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert NWB data to decoder format')\\\\n    parser.add_argument('output', help='Output pickle file path')\\\\n \\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"=\\\\\\\" * 60)\\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"NWB to Decoder Format Conversion\\\\\\\")\\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"=\\\\\\\" * 60)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Find all NWB files\\\\n    nwb_files = Normalize by the fraction of non-NaN values\\\\n    ones = np.ones_like(a)\\\\n    ones[nan_mask] = 0\\\\n    norm = gaussian_filter1d(ones, sig, axis=axis)\\\\n    norm[norm == 0] = 1  # avoid division by zero\\\\n    result = smoothed / norm\\\\n    result[nan_mask] = np.nan\\\\n    return result\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef determine_reward_zone_label(rz_start_pos):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Determine reward zone label (A/B/C) from start position.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    if np.isnan(rz_start_pos):\\\\n        return None\\\\n    for label, (start, end) in REWARD_ZONES.items():\\\\n        if start - 20 < rz_start_pos < end + 20:  # allow some tolerance\\\\n            return label\\\\n    return None\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_reward_zone_start_per_trial(pos, rzone, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get reward zone start position for each trial.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n_trials = len(trial_start_inds)\\\\n    rz_starts = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)\\\\n    rz_labels = [None] * n_trials\\\\n    \\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        trial_rzone = rzone[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_pos = pos[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        rz_active = trial_rzone > 0\\\\n        if np.any(rz_active):\\\\n            # Get the minimum position where rzone is active\\\\n            rz_start_pos = trial_pos[rz_active].min()\\\\n            rz_starts[t] = rz_start_pos\\\\n            rz_labels[t] = determine_reward_zone_label(rz_start_pos)\\\\n    \\\\n    return rz_starts, rz_labels\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, trial_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get the reward zone label for a specific trial.\\\\n    For omission trials, infer from neighboring trials.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    if rz_labels[trial_idx] is not None:\\\\n        return rz_labels[trial_idx]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Search forward and backward for nearest non-None label\\\\n    for offset in range(1, len(rz_labels)):\\\\n        if trial_idx - offset >= 0 and rz_labels[trial_idx - offset] is not None:\\\\n            return rz_labels[trial_idx - offset]\\\\n        if trial_idx + offset < len(rz_labels) and rz_labels[trial_idx + offset] is not None:\\\\n            return rz_labels[trial_idx + offset]\\\\n    \\\\n    return 'A'  # fallback\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_distance_to_reward_zone(position, rz_start):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute signed distance from current position to nearest point in reward zone.\\\\n    Reward zone spans [rz_start, rz_start + 50].\\\\n    Negative = before reward zone, positive = after.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    rz_end = rz_start + 50.0\\\\n    distance = np.zeros_like(position)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Before reward zone\\\\n    before_mask = position < rz_start\\\\n    distance[before_mask] = position[before_mask] - rz_start\\\\n    \\\\n    # In reward zone\\\\n    in_mask = (position >= rz_start) & (position <= rz_end)\\\\n    distance[in_mask] = 0.0\\\\n    \\\\n    # After reward zone\\\\n    after_mask = position > rz_end\\\\n    distance[after_mask] = position[after_mask] - rz_end\\\\n    \\\\n    return distance\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_distance(distance):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize distance to reward zone into 7 bins.\\\\n    0: < -50 cm\\\\n    1: -50 to -10 cm\\\\n    2: -10 cm to < 0 cm\\\\n    3: 0 cm\\\\n    4: >0 cm to +10 cm\\\\n    5: +10 to +50 cm\\\\n    6: > +50 cm\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bins = np.zeros(len(distance), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    bins[distance < -50] = 0\\\\n    bins[(distance >= -50) & (distance < -10)] = 1\\\\n    bins[(distance >= -10) & (distance < 0)] = 2\\\\n    bins[distance == 0] = 3\\\\n    bins[(distance > 0) & (distance <= 10)] = 4\\\\n    bins[(distance > 10) & (distance <= 50)] = 5\\\\n    bins[distance > 50] = 6\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_position(position, n_bins=5):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize absolute position into n_bins equal-sized bins.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, TRACK_LENGTH, n_bins + 1)\\\\n    bins = np.digitize(position, bin_edges[1:])  # 0 to n_bins-1\\\\n    bins = np.clip(bins, 0, n_bins - 1)\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_speed(speed):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize speed into 5 bins.\\\\n    0: < 2 cm/s\\\\n    1: 2-10 cm/s\\\\n    2: 10-20 cm/s\\\\n    3: 20-40 cm/s\\\\n    4: > 40 cm/s\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    bins[speed < 2] = 0\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 2) & (speed < 10)] = 1\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 10) & (speed < 20)] = 2\\\\n    bins[(speed >= 20) & (speed < 40)] = 3\\\\n    bins[speed >= 40] = 4\\\\n    return bins\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_licks(lick_data, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process lick data following reference code logic.\\\\n    1. Detect and remove lick sensor errors\\\\n    2. Clip to [0, 1] (binary)\\\\n    3. Smooth with Gaussian\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    licks = np.copy(lick_data).astype(np.float64)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Lick sensor error correction per trial\\\\n    for t in range(len(trial_start_inds)):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        trial_licks = licks[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        # If >35% of samples have cumulative lick count > 2, set to NaN\\\\n        if len(trial_licks) > 0:\\\\n            frac_high = np.sum(trial_licks > 2) / len(trial_licks)\\\\n            if frac_high > LICK_ERROR_THRESHOLD:\\\\n                licks[t_start:t_end] = np.nan\\\\n    \\\\n    # Clip to [0, 1]\\\\n    licks[licks > 1] = 1\\\\n    \\\\n    return licks\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process a single NWB file and return trial-level data.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    t0 = time.time()\\\\n    \\\\n    f = h5py.File(nwb_path, 'r')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract metadata\\\\n    subj_id = f['general']['subject']['subject_id'][()].decode()\\\\n    sess_id = f['general']['session_id'][()].decode()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract behavioral data\\\\n    beh = f['processing']['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries']\\\\n    position = beh['position']['data'][:]\\\\n    speed_data = beh['speed']['data'][:]\\\\n    lick_data = beh['lick']['data'][:]\\\\n    rzone = beh['reward_zone']['data'][:]\\\\n    env_data = beh['environment']['data'][:]\\\\n    trial_start_markers = beh['trial_start']['data'][:]\\\\n    teleport_markers = beh['teleport']['data'][:]\\\\n    scanning = beh['scanning']['data'][:]\\\\n    reward_timestamps = beh['Reward']['timestamps'][:]\\\\n    pos_timestamps = beh['position']['timestamps'][:]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Extract neural data\\\\n    deconv_data = f['processing']['ophys']['Deconvolved']['plane0']['data'][:]  # (n_timepoints, n_rois)\\\\n    iscell = f['processing']['ophys']['ImageSegmentation']['PlaneSegmentation']['iscell'][:]\\\\n    \\\\n    f.close()\\\\n    \\\\n    # Filter neurons by iscell\\\\n    cell_mask = iscell[:, 0] == 1\\\\n    neural_all = deconv_data[:, cell_mask].T  # (n_neurons, n_timepoints)\\\\n    n_neurons = neural_all.shape[0]\\\\n    n_timepoints = neural_all.shape[1]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get trial boundaries\\\\n    trial_start_inds = np.where(trial_start_markers > 0)[0]\\\\n    teleport_inds = np.where(teleport_markers > 0)[0]\\\\n    n_trials = len(trial_start_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    if n_trials != len(teleport_inds):\\\\n        print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: trial_start ({n_trials}) != teleport ({len(teleport_inds)}) count\\\\\\\")\\\\n        n_trials = min(n_trials, len(teleport_inds))\\\\n        trial_start_inds = trial_start_inds[:n_trials]\\\\n        teleport_inds = teleport_inds[:n_trials]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Compute frame rate\\\\n    dt = np.median(np.diff(pos_timestamps))\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone info per trial\\\\n    rz_starts, rz_labels = get_reward_zone_start_per_trial(\\\\n        position, rzone, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Process licks\\\\n    licks_processed = process_licks(lick_data, trial_start_inds, teleport_inds)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Determine reward per trial\\\\n    # Convert reward timestamps to frame indices\\\\n    reward_frame_inds = np.searchsorted(pos_timestamps, reward_timestamps)\\\\n    reward_frame_inds = np.clip(reward_frame_inds, 0, n_timepoints - 1)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build per-trial reward binary\\\\n    trial_rewarded = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        # Check if any reward was delivered in this trial\\\\n        reward_in_trial = np.any(\\\\n            (reward_frame_inds >= t_start) & (reward_frame_inds < t_end)\\\\n        )\\\\n        trial_rewarded[t] = 1 if reward_in_trial else 0\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get environment type per trial\\\\n    trial_env = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        env_vals = env_data[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        env_vals = env_vals[env_vals >= 0]  # exclude -1\\\\n        if len(env_vals) > 0:\\\\n            trial_env[t] = int(np.median(env_vals))\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone label per trial (for output)\\\\n    trial_rz_label = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    rz_label_map = {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, t)\\\\n        trial_rz_label[t] = rz_label_map.get(label, 0)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Get reward zone start position per trial (for distance computation)\\\\n    # For omission trials, use the same reward zone as neighboring trials\\\\n    trial_rz_start = np.zeros(n_trials)\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        label = get_reward_zone_for_trial(rz_labels, t)\\\\n        trial_rz_start[t] = REWARD_ZONES[label][0]\\\\n    \\\\n    # Build trial data\\\\n    neural_trials = []\\\\n    input_trials = []\\\\n    output_trials = []\\\\n    \\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        t_start = trial_start_inds[t]\\\\n        t_end = teleport_inds[t]\\\\n        n_tp = t_end - t_start\\\\n        \\\\n        if n_tp < 2:\\\\n            continue\\\\n        \\\\n        # Neural data for this trial\\\\n        trial_neural = neural_all[:, t_start:t_end].astype(np.float32)\\\\n        \\\\n        # --- INPUTS ---\\\\n        # Time from start of trial (seconds)\\\\n        time_from_start = np.arange(n_tp) * dt\\\\n        \\\\n        # Environment type (binary, per trial)\\\\n        env_type = float(trial_env[t])\\\\n        \\\\n        # Trial number (continuous, per trial)\\\\n        trial_num = float(t)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Previous trial outcome (binary, per trial)\\\\n        if t == 0:\\\\n            prev_outcome = 0.0\\\\n        else:\\\\n            prev_outcome = float(trial_rewarded[t - 1])\\\\n        \\\\n        # Build input array\\\\n        # Time-varying: time_from_start (n_tp,)\\\\n        # Per-trial: env_type, trial_num, prev_outcome\\\\n        input_data = np.zeros((4, n_tp), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        input_data[0, :] = time_from_start\\\\n        input_data[1, :] = env_type\\\\n        input_data[2, :] = trial_num\\\\n        input_data[3, :] = prev_outcome\\\\n        \\\\n        # --- OUTPUTS ---\\\\n        trial_pos = position[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_speed = speed_data[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        trial_licks = licks_processed[t_start:t_end]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Distance to reward zone (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n        rz_start = trial_rz_start[t]\\\\n        distance = compute_distance_to_reward_zone(trial_pos, rz_start)\\\\n        dist_bins = discretize_distance(distance)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Absolute position (time-varying, discretized into 5 bins)\\\\n        pos_bins = discretize_position(trial_pos, n_bins=5)\\\\n        \\\\n        # Speed (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n        speed_bins = discretize_speed(np.abs(trial_speed))  # use absolute speed\\\\n        \\\\n        # Lick (time-varying, binary)\\\\n        lick_binary = np.zeros(n_tp, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        if not np.all(np.isnan(trial_licks)):\\\\n            # Smooth licks\\\\n            smoothed_licks = nansmooth(trial_licks, LICK_SMOOTH_SIGMA)\\\\n            # Convert to binary: > 0.5 threshold after smoothing\\\\n            lick_binary = (smoothed_licks > 0.5).astype(np.int64)\\\\n            lick_binary[np.isnan(smoothed_licks)] = 0\\\\n        \\\\n        # Reward zone location (per-trial)\\\\n        rz_loc = trial_rz_label[t]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Reward outcome (per-trial)\\\\n        reward_out = trial_rewarded[t]\\\\n        \\\\n        # Build output array\\\\n        # Time-varying: dist_bins, pos_bins, speed_bins, lick_binary\\\\n        # Per-trial: rz_loc, reward_out\\\\n        output_data = np.zeros((6, n_tp), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        output_data[0, :] = dist_bins\\\\n        output_data[1, :] = pos_bins\\\\n        output_data[2, :] = speed_bins\\\\n        output_data[3, :] = lick_binary\\\\n        output_data[4, :] = rz_loc\\\\n        output_data[5, :] = reward_out\\\\n        \\\\n        neural_trials.append(trial_neural)\\\\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\\\\n        output_trials.append(output_data)\\\\n    \\\\n    elapsed = time.time() - t0\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"  {subj_id} ses-{sess_id}: {n_neurons} neurons, {len(neural_trials)} trials, \\\\\\\"\\\\n          f\\\\\\\"{n_tp} timepoints (last trial), dt={dt*1000:.1f}ms, {elapsed:.1f}s\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    if show_processing and session_idx < 2:\\\\n        plot_processing(subj_id, sess_id, position, speed_data, licks_processed,\\\\n                       trial_start_inds, teleport_inds, neural_all, \\\\n                       rz_starts, rz_labels, trial_rewarded, trial_env,\\\\n                       pos_timestamps, dt, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                       session_idx)\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n        'neural_trials': neural_trials,\\\\n        'input_trials': input_trials,\\\\n        'output_trials': output_trials,\\\\n        'subj_id': subj_id,\\\\n        'sess_id': sess_id,\\\\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\\\\n        'dt': dt,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef plot_processing(subj_id, sess_id, position, speed, licks,\\\\n                   trial_start_inds, teleport_inds, neural_all,\\\\n                   rz_starts, rz_labels, trial_rewarded, trial_env,\\\\n                   pos_timestamps, dt, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                   session_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Plot processing steps for visual verification.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    import matplotlib\\\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\\\n    \\\\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(6, 2,      ax.set_title('Distance to RZ (Trial 0)')\\\\n    \\\\n    # Plot 6: Position bins (first trial)\\\\n    ax = axes[2, 1]\\\\n    if len(output_trials) > 0:\\\\n        ax.plot(output_trials[0][1, main():\\\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert NWB data to decoder format')\\\\n    parser.add_argument('output', help='Output pickle file path')\\\\n parser.add_argument('--show-processing', action='store_true', help='Show processing plots')\\\\n    args = parser.parse_args()\\\\n    \\\\n    if args.sample:\\\\n        args.full = False\\\\n    \\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"=\\\\\\\" * 60)\\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"NWB to Decoder Format Conversion\\\\\\\")\\\\n    print(\\\\\\\"=\\\\\\\" * 60)\\\\n    \\\\n    # Find all NWB files\\\\n    nwb_files = sorted(glob.glob('data/sub-*/sub-*_ses-*_behavior+ophys.nwb'))\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"Found {len(nwb_files)} NWB files\\\\\\\")\\\\n    \\\\n    if args.sample:\\\\n        # Select 2 sessions from \\\\n    # Process all sessions\\\\n    all_neural = []\\\\n    all_input = []\\\\n    all_output = []\\\\n    all_subj_ids = []\\\\n    all_sess_ids = []\\\\n    all_n_neurons = []\\\\n    all_dts = brain_region_idx = []\\\\n    for n_neurons in all_n_neurons:\\\\n        brain_region_idx.append(np.zeros(n_neurons, dtype=np.int64))  # all CA1\\\\n    \\\\n    # Compute median dt for metadata\\\\n Discretization bins:\\n  - 0:  < -50 cm\\n  - 1: -50 to -10 cm\\n  - 2: -10 cm to < 0 cm\\n  - 3: 0 cm\\n  - 4: >0 cm to +10 cm\\n  - 5: +10 to +50 cm\\n  - 6: > +50 cm\\n- Absolute position in corridor, discretized into 5 equal-sized bins, time-varying\\n- Speed, time-varying. Discretized into bins:\\n  - 0: < 2 cm/s\\n  - 1: 2-10 cm/s\\n  - 2: 10-20 cm/s\\n  - 3: 20-40 cm/s\\n  - 4: > 40 cm/s\\n- Lick, time-varying. 0 = no, 1 = yes\\n- Reward zone location, per-trial. 0 = A, 1 = B, 2 = C\\n- Reward outcome, per-trial. 0 = no, 1 = yes\\n\\n## Target Data Format\\n\\n- Save the full converted dataset to the pickle file `converted_data.pkl`.\\n- All datasets must be converted into the following Python dictionary structure:\\n\\n```python\\ndata = {\\n    'neural': [  # list of sessions\\n        [  # list of trials for session 1\\n            neuron_by_time_matrix,  # shape: (n_neurons, n_timepoints)\\n            neuron_by_time_matrix,  # trial 2\\n            ...\\n        ],\\n        [  # list of trials for session 2\\n            ...\\n        ],\\n        ...\\n    ],\\n\\n    'input': [  # list of sessions\\n        [  # list of trials for session 1\\n            input_data,  # stimulus/task variables, shape: (n_input, n_timepoints) or (n_input)\\n            ...\\n        ],\\n        ...\\n    ],\\n\\n    'output': [  # list of sessions\\n        [  # list of trials for session 1\\n            output_data,  # behavioral response, shape (n_output, n_timepoints) or (n_output)\\n            ...\\n        ],\\n        ...\\n    ],\\n\\n    'subjects': list of str, # ids of all subjects, length n_subjects\\n    'subject_idx': shape (n_sessions,), # index into subjects for each session\\n\\n    'brain_regions': list of str, # names of the brain regions recorded from, e.g. ALM, V1\\n    'brain_region_idx': [ # list of sessions\\n        neuron_region_idx, # shape: (n_neurons,)\\n    ], # index into `brain_regions` for each neuron\\n\\n    'input_names': list of str, # names for each input, of length n_input\\n    'output_names': list of str, # names of each output, of length n_output\\n    'output_values': [ # list of length n_output\\n        [ output_val0, ... ], # list of str of length d_output[0], name of each output value\\n        ...\\n    ],\\n\\n    'metadata': {\\n        'task_description': str, # description of output tasks\\n        'time_bin_size': float, # length of time bin in ms\\n        'temporal_alignment_event': str, # description of alignment event\\n        'off_start': float or None, # signed time from alignment event to start of trial in seconds, None if N/A\\n        'off_end': float or None, # signed time from alignment event to end of trial in seconds, None if N/A\\n        ...\\n    }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### Key Format Requirements\\n\\n- **neural**: Neural activity data (e.g., firing rates, spike counts) organized by session and trial\\n  - Dimensions: (n_neurons, n_timepoints) for each trial.\\n  - Time bins should be the same size for all trials and sessions. \\n  - There needs to be at least two trials within each session in order to evaluate the decoder performance.\\n\\n- **input**: Variables that serve as inputs **to the decoder**\\n  - These are **decoder inputs**. They could be task inputs to the animal, but inputs to the animal can also be decoder outputs.\\n  - Examples: time from an aligning signal, stimulus characteristics, our animal behavior such as:\\n    - visual: contrast, position, orientation\\n    - audio: frequency, amplitude\\n    - behavior: running speed, pupil size\\n  - Dimensions: (d_input, n_timepoints) for each trial. \\n  - Should capture all relevant contextual information for the decoder\\n  - If an input is a time such as onset of some stimulus, represent it as a binary time series. \\n\\n- **output**: Variables to be decoded/predicted from neural activity\\n  - These are what we want the decoder to **predict**. They could be the animal's output behavior or properties of the stimulus.\\n  - Output variables must be **categorical**, i.e. discrete rather than continuous. If a variable is not discrete, follow instructions from Decoder Task to discretize it. \\n  - Examples: stimulus properties (contrast, orientation), choice (left/right), reaction time, position\\n  - Can be time-varying or discrete values per trial. If at all possible, make it time-varying\\n  - If an output is a time such as when a behavior occurred, represent it as a binary time series. \\n\\n- **subjects**: List of names of all unique subjects (mice).\\n- **subject_idx**: Index into subjects for each session.\\n  - Order should match order of sessions in `neural`, etc.\\n\\n- **brain_regions**: List of names of all brain regions recorded from.\\n- **brain_region_idx**: Index into brain_regions for each neuron in each session.\\n\\n- **input_names**: Names of each input variable.\\n  - Order should match order of `input` dimensions. \\n\\n- **output_names**: Names of each output variable.\\n  - Order should match order of `output` dimensions.\\n- **output_values**: Names of each output value for each output variable.\\n  - Order should match categorical `output` values.\\n\\n- **metadata**: Descriptive information. \\n  - `task_description`: Concise description of the task\\n  - `temporal_alignment_event`: Concise description of temporal alignment event\\n  - `off_start`: Signed time from alignment event to start of trial. Negative means before event, positive after. \\n  - `off_end`: Signed time from alignment event to end of trial\\n  - Add other relevant fields, e.g. `session_info`\\n\\n## Python environment\\n\\n- All required Python packages are already installed in the system Python environment.\\n- Use `python3` to run any python code.\\n- If you need to install additional libraries, use `pip install`.\\n\\n## Decoder Reference\\n\\n- Run this script with `python train_decoder.py <data_file_path>` to validate.\\n- Optional arguments:\\n  - `--verify-only`: Only verify data format and print summary, then exit (does not train decoder).\\n  - `--plot-samples`: Plot sample trials from data and save to png files.\\n  - `--cpu`: Force torch to use CPU only (use if GPU runs out of memory).\\n- Pipe the output to the designated file so that the user can examine it.\\n\\n### Purpose\\n\\nThese functions will be used during the validation phase to ensure:\\n1. Data structure is correct - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \\n2. Dimensions are consistent - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \\n3. Values are sensible - will report errors and warnings to stdout. \\n4. Decoder can successfully train and predict\\n5. Poor performance indicates data formatting issues that need investigation\\n\\n### Consistency requirements\\n\\nYour processing and formatting must **match the reference paper and code** with respect to:\\n- Loading of data\\n- Temporal alignment of different time series streams (neural, inputs, outputs)\\n- Processing of neural, input, and output data streams\\n- Curation of data: filtering of low-quality neurons, trials, sessions, and mice.\\n\\nTo check consistency, you must compare statistics available in the reference paper and your converted dataset. \\n\\nWhenever possible, invent **SANITY CHECKS** that your loading and processing matches the reference paper and code. \\n\\nDiscrepancies are only allowed if required by the Decoder Input and Decoder Output specifications above. \\n\\nCarefully verify your work after every step. When you find mistakes, document and fix them immediately. Be critical of results **after every step of processing**. \\n\\nYou will be assessed on whether the decisions you make on how to load, filter, process, align, reformat, and save the data are reasonable and match the reference paper and code and these instructions. During testing, the reference version of `train_decoder.py` will be run on your converted data. Data statistics and decoder accuracy will be compared to those achieved by human-written conversion code. \\n\\n---\\n\\n## Conversion Workflow\\n\\n**IMPORTANT**: Follow these steps in order. It first computes the position of the min and max position of the mouse when `reward_zone` is non-zero:\\n   306→```python\\n   307→behavior_data = nwbfile.processing['behavior']['BehavioralTimeSeries'].time_series       \\n   308→info['reward_zone_positions'] = np.full((ntrials, 2), np.nan)\\n   309→position = behavior_data['position'].data[:]\\n   310→for trial in range(ntrials):\\n   311→    idx = np.arange(trial_start_idx[trial], trial_end_idx[trial], dtype=int)\\n   312→    pos_trial = position[idx]\\n   313→    reward_zone_trial = reward_zone[idx] > 0\\n   314→    if not np.any(reward_zone_trial):\\n   315→        continue\\n   316→    info['reward_zone_positions'][trial] = [np.min(pos_trial[reward_zone_trial]), np.max(pos_trial[reward_zone_trial])]\\n   317→```\\n   318→The function `segment_reward_positions()` uses the Viterbi algorithm to assign reward zone labels so that the initial rewarded positions are close to the corresponding rewarded zone:\\n   319→```python\\n   320→reward_zone_dict = {'A': [80, 130],\\n   321→                    'B': [200, 250],\\n   322→                    'C': [320, 370]}\\n   323→...\\n   324→sigma = 10.0  # std dev for Gaussian emission on zone distance\\n   325→zone_ranges = np.array([reward_zone_dict[z] for z in zone_names])  # (n_states, 2)\\n   326→dist = np.maximum(zone_ranges[None, :, 0] - startpoints[valid, None],\\n   327→                    startpoints[valid, None] - zone_ranges[None, :, 1]) # negative if inside the zone, positive if outside\\n   328→dist = np.maximum(dist, 0)\\n   329→log_emission[valid] = -0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2\\n   330→```\\n   331→It also encourages the reward zone label to not change often:\\n   332→```python\\n   333→pstay = .9\\n   334→log_trans = np.full((n_states, n_states), np.log((1 - pstay) / (n_states - 1)))\\n   335→np.fill_diagonal(log_trans, np.log(pstay))\\n   336→```\\n   337→\\n   338→iii.
